text:
alex-k: Quick post-engagement triage for the ACME engagement (whitebox). Report landed at 09:02. attaching quick notes here so we can coordinate remediations + retest orchestration.

maria-s: Thanks. Can we confirm evidence packaging location and what artifacts the assessor included?

penbot: Report uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/pen-tests/acme/3141592653/report.pdf 
Metadata: report_id=ACME-2026-3141592653, assessor=NightfallSec, severity_summary=3 high, 12 med, 21 low.

cheng-l: I pulled the S3 bundle. There are PoC scripts + curl logs and a few DB snapshots (sanitized). I put them in /evidence/acme/3141592653/ (presigned link in ticket).

samir: High-level ask: which findings require RBAC changes vs config/observability work? I can triage a first pass.

alex-k: Good Q. From a skim: two authz findings (token replay + excessive role permission on kube-deploy), one KMS misuse pattern (improper ciphertext handling on staging), and a few telemetry blindspots.

maria-s: I'll own the RBAC items. Plan: create least-privilege patches for the kube role and a short-lived token policy. Need owners for validation and for audit log proofing.

cheng-l: I'll take KMS integration questions. Need to reproduce the ciphertext flow, looks like they used the old client that didn't use AEAD.

iris: I'll handle observability gaps + evidence that logs were forwarded. We need replayable proofs for retest: full trace IDs and signed snapshots.

samir: Proposed workflow: 1) create JIRA tickets per finding with remediation steps + temp owners 2) patch in a staging branch behind feature flag 3) run QA / exploit regression harness 4) schedule retest window (48-72h after patch merged).

alex-k: +1. Make sure every ticket has a "proof-of-fix checklist" with exact log lines and KMS decrypt traces we expect to see. Example checklist snippet: 
```
- Deploy patched role (kube-deploy-restrict) to staging
- Rotate ephemeral tokens for CI runners
- Trigger sample request that previously leaked role assumption headers
- Confirm audit log entry: audit.user=kube-ci AND action=assume_role AND allowed=false
- Confirm KMS DECRYPT logs: key_id=projects/redwood/keys/staging, request_id=abc123, result=OK
```

maria-s: For RBAC patches: I'll open tickets ENGSEC-3141 (kube role) and ENGSEC-3142 (CI token policy). I'll assign to @cheng-l for verification of side effects and to @infra oncall for rollout.

cheng-l: For KMS: can you add the exact sample payloads from the PoC to the ticket? I need them to reproduce. Also, what KMS client versions are running in staging vs prod?

alex-k: PoC payloads are in the evidence bundle under /pocs/kms_misuse/*. Staging uses libkms 2.0.1; prod still at 1.9.8 (yikes). We'll need a compatibility plan if we recommend client upgrade.

iris: Observability note: the assessors flagged missing correlation IDs for async jobs. Short-term mitigation: add request_id propagation for job schedulers + sample query for logs. I can draft the query for the retest acceptance criteria.

samir: Risk gating: anything blocking prod rollback? Prefer to keep fixes staged behind feature flags and not rotate keys in prod until retest confirms fixes. For KMS, do not rotate key material unless necessary.

maria-s: A couple of logistical asks: 
- Can security ops host a 30-min remediation kickoff today?
- Who will be point for handing the evidence to the assessor for retest?

alex-k: I'm available at 14:00. @penbot, can you provision a shortlived "readroom" presigned URL for the assessor to pull artifacts after we finalize the fixes?

penbot: Readroom link created: https://readroom.redwood.internal/acme/3141592653?token=xxxx (expires 72h). Access log: will be captured in audit.bucket_access.

cheng-l: For the retest window, propose dates: Thu 2026-03-26 06:00-10:00 UTC (staging only) and Fri 2026-03-27 08:00-12:00 UTC (prod smoke if needed). That gives infra time to promote if good.

iris: Need to document the exact log queries we expect assessor to run and the time ranges. I'll draft an "acceptance query" doc and attach to each ticket.

samir: Let's be explicit about verification artifacts for closure: 
- audit export (CSV) showing denied assume_role entries during test 
- KMS operation logs with request_ids and key_id matching the proof checklist 
- patched role diffs + helm chart image/tag 
- replayable harness output (stdout + exit codes)

maria-s: I'll update the RBAC tickets with owners and add the acceptance artifacts list. Aiming for remediation PRs by EOD.

alex-k: One more: incident response readiness. If we discover a regression during retest, we need a rollback corridor. @infra oncall will keep rollback runbook at hand and we will have an emergency bridge channel.

cheng-l: Agreed. Also create a short runbook for KMS client rollback (how to pin clients to 1.9.8 if upgrade causes issues).

samir: I'll create the coordination ticket ENGSEC-COORD-314159 with links to each fix ticket + retest windows, and invite assessor contact.

iris: Thanks. I'll put together the acceptance queries and example log lines and drop them in the tickets.

maria-s: kickoff at 14:00 — see you there. :thumbsup:

alex-k: Thanks all. We'll track progress in ENGSEC-COORD-314159 and update this thread with any blockers.

penbot: Reminder: assessor retest slot request received at 13:30. Please confirm final window by EOD to lock.

samir: Confirmed. Closing plan: triage -> tickets -> patch -> QA harness -> retest windows as above. If anything changes, ping here.

alex-k: End of thread notes: add "post-mortem light" item for infra to review KMS client upgrade policy.
